FAQs
What time is check-in and check-out?
Check in is from 3pm and check out is at 12pm
What facilities and services are available at The Soho Hotel?
24 hour room service
Concierge
Guest Drawing Room and Library
Restaurant and Bar
Screening Rooms
Private Dining and Meeting Rooms
Gym
Spa treatment room
Valet
What in-room amenities do you offer?
Writing Desk
Flat Screen LCD TV
Tivoli Radio
Bose SoundLink
High speed wireless internet access
Fully stocked Mini Bar
Bed linen by Firmdale Sleep
RikRak bath & body products
Chromecast
Two line telephones with voicemail
Personal safe
Do you cater for families and children?
Yes, we are family-friendly and have tailored amenities available for children at The Soho Hotel:
Cots
High chairs
Babysitting
Children's menus
Children's books and board games
Milk & cookies at bedtime
Mini bathrobes
Bathroom amenities for babies and children
Welcome gift to suit the child's age
Are you a dog-friendly hotel?
Yes, all dogs are welcome to stay at The Soho Hotel. However, only guide dogs are permitted in our restaurant.
Are there any special offers available for stays in London?
Yes, our special offers change regularly. With reduced rates and exciting extras, they are the perfect way to make the most of luxury stay or weekend city break. Explore our latest offers here.
What dining and bar experiences can I find at The Soho Hotel?
Our Refuel Restaurant and Bar at The Soho Hotel offers modern British and European dining in the heart of Soho, serving brasserie classics with a twist as well as contemporary seasonal specials. Just moments away from some of London’s most popular theatres, we offer set menus for pre and post-theatre or group dining, as well as afternoon tea and Sunday roast.
In the cocktail bar, we serve an extensive wine list and classic tipples, as well as signatures like our ‘Nine Regions’ cocktails , which celebrate independent producers across England. Every Wednesday, you can enjoy live music performances from 7pm - 9pm.
Do you have any private event spaces available for hire?
Yes, we have a selection of flexible and stylish event spaces available in London's Soho neighbourhood. From private dining rooms for special celebrations to creative meeting rooms and luxurious screening facilities for media events, we can accommodate both intimate gatherings and larger functions, for leisure and business travel alike.
Explore our spaces here .
What is there to do in Soho during my stay?
London's buzzy Soho neighbourhood is brimming with things to see and do and The Soho Hotel is the perfect place from which to explore. Some of our highlights include:
Theatres : The London Palladium, Dominion Theatre and @sohoplace are all within close proximity to The Soho Hotel.
Museums : You can explore a variety of musems nearby, from soaking up the historic culture of British Museum to immersing yourself in an illusion experience at Twist Museum.
Galleries : Soho is home to independent galleries including The Photographer's Gallery and Frith Street Gallery.
Shopping : The Soho Hotel is located moments from Oxford Street and Carnaby Street, where you can find the iconic Liberty and Selfridge's as well as a host of top high-street brands.
Green Spaces : Hidden within the busy streets is the small Soho Square, a peaceful spot to unwind in warmer months, just a three minute walk from The Soho Hotel.
What are the closest stations to The Soho Hotel?
Tottenham Court Road, Oxford Circus and Piccadilly Circus underground stations are all located near The Soho Hotel:
Tottenham Court Road: 3-minute walk
Oxford Circus: 10-minute walk
Piccadilly Circus: 11-minute walk
From tales of design to exclusive events, and seasonal menus, our Soho Hotel newsletters are brimming with stories for the curious and the creative.
